faqs.question: How long does it take to launch a new website?
faqs.answer: Most Prairie Web Studio projects launch within 7 business days after we receive your content and brand details. Larger multi-page sites may take up to two weeks.

faqs.question: Do you only work with businesses in Great Bend?
faqs.answer: We specialize in Great Bend and Central Kansas, but we work remotely with small businesses across Kansas. Every site includes local SEO setup tailored to your service area.

faqs.question: What SEO is included with every website?
faqs.answer: Every site comes ready to be found. We write clear page titles and descriptions, add your business name, hours, and location in the format Google reads, and include a sitemap so search engines can list all your pages. The technical SEO is handled behind the scenes — you don't have to think about any of it.

faqs.question: Will my website score 90-100 on Google Lighthouse?
faqs.answer: Yes — we build every site to score 90-100 on Google's Lighthouse checks for speed, ease of use, and search-friendliness. In plain terms: your pages load fast, work great on phones, and look good to Google. No clunky page builders weighing things down.

faqs.question: Do I own my website after launch?
faqs.answer: With Own It Outright, you own the site from day one. Launch & Support lowers your upfront build cost. Either build plan can pair with a maintenance subscription for ongoing updates and monitoring — we can discuss ownership transfer anytime.
